NDT software in Saskatoon: inspection management for potash, uranium and power

Saskatoon sits in the middle of the world's largest potash-producing region. Nutrien is headquartered in the city, and its Allan, Cory, Patience Lake, Lanigan and Vanscoy operations surround it, along with Mosaic's Colonsay mine and BHP's Jansen project east of the city. Cameco is also based in Saskatoon, and the uranium mines and mills of the Athabasca Basin in the north are served by fly-in rotations that often start here. Add SaskPower's Queen Elizabeth station in the city, heavy oil and upgrading around Lloydminster to the west, and a strong base of fabrication and manufacturing shops, and a Saskatoon NDT company has a workload quite unlike Alberta's.

Mine and mill work means corrosive brine, big rotating equipment, structural welds, tanks, hoists and headframes, plus shutdowns scheduled around production. The Atlantis ERP solution gives a Saskatoon inspection company one system configured for NDT: technician certifications, procedures, instruments and calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quotes and invoicing, all tied to the same job. It is affordable, accessible and fully customized. Demo and quote on request.

ERP for NDT companies in Saskatoon: matching apps to mine and mill work

An ERP for NDT companies in Saskatoon has to handle mine-site shutdowns, northern fly-in rotations and steady shop work in the same database. The Atlantis ERP does it with NDT-specific apps.

  • NDT Reports for 17 report types, including MFL, UT thickness, holiday/coating and MT common in potash plants.
  • Team Assignments for shutdown crews and northern rotations.
  • Certificates for certifications, vision tests and radiation safety details.
  • Asset Management for instruments, calibration, maintenance and consumables.
  • Procedures for controlled procedures that mine owners audit.
  • Quotations, Timesheets and Invoicing for shutdown and call-out billing.

Supporting apps include Project, CRM, Fleet, Purchase, Maintenance, Employees and Dashboards.

NDT reporting software for potash mines and mills

NDT reporting software for potash work has to cover a wider method mix than most refinery jobs. Brine and salt are hard on steel, so mills generate a steady flow of thickness surveys on tanks, chutes, piping and ductwork, coating and lining checks, tank floor scans and weld inspection on structural steel, conveyors and process equipment. The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types, including UT thickness with readings by direction, MFL with scan mode and item lines for tank floors, holiday/coating for lined equipment, MT with technique and particle type for structural welds, and UT, PAUT and TOFD for pressure and critical welds.

RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement; PT reports capture method and developer; PMI, hardness, ferrite and PWHT reports cover alloy repairs. Weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation, and each report closes with acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. Work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references are all captured, which makes it easy to tie a finding back to a mine's own maintenance work order.

Reports run through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party inspector field. Versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF and HTML carry your logo, and Excel templates fill automatically from mapped cells. The offline field app works underground-adjacent and in mill buildings where signal is poor, storing drafts and photos until it syncs. For a 3D view of thickness data and indications on mill equipment, see Atlantis Digital Twins and Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for mine shutdowns and northern rotations

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Saskatoon has to handle two rhythms: planned mill shutdowns within driving distance of the city, and fly-in rotations to northern sites. In Team Assignments each job moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable entries, and overlaps are blocked. Rotation blocks for a northern contract can be entered as unavailable periods, so dispatch does not accidentally put a technician on a Lanigan shutdown while they are scheduled to fly north. Equipment serial numbers cannot be double-booked, and the dispatcher is warned if an assigned instrument is out of calibration, which matters when kit is going somewhere it cannot easily be swapped.

Technician status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date are shown in calendar, kanban and list views. The Project app records site, client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria and safety induction and work permit fields, useful for mines where each site has its own orientation. Tasks within a project carry method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, and procedure and WPS references, so a shutdown with hundreds of inspection points stays organised.

Technician certification tracking software, including radiation safety details

Technician certification tracking software for Saskatoon covers more than NDT levels. Mine clients want certificates on file before site access, and radiography crews carry radiation safety paperwork too. Each certification record in the Atlantis ERP holds scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT and training hours, exam result and attachments, and status is computed as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked.

Most technicians in Saskatchewan hold ISO 9712 certificates through the Canadian national program run by the Canadian General Standards Board (formerly NRCan); the register also holds SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes. The employee NDT profile records highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. An exposure device operator certificate can be stored as a certificate record with its own expiry so it gets the same alerts as an NDT certificate.

Vision tests are tracked with Jaeger near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner and clinic. The ERP creates warning tasks 90 days before expiry, sends configurable email alerts and warns on timesheets when a technician without a valid certificate logs hours. Atlantis provides ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based training through eLearning, useful for crews on rotation who can study between shifts; other schemes are recorded, not trained.

Calibration management software for kit that goes north

When an instrument flies to a northern site, you cannot send a replacement the same day. Calibration management software for Saskatoon has to prevent that problem before the kit leaves. The Atlantis ERP tracks each instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status, including in calibration, in repair and rented out.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date. The certificate register tracks valid, expiring and expired status, stores the PDF and lab accreditation number and sends alerts. Issue and return goes through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded at both ends, and reservations prevent two jobs claiming the same unit. Inbound and outbound movement records show what went north and what came back.

The maintenance log covers preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement. Salt-laden mill air is hard on connectors and cables, and the log shows which kit keeps coming back for the same repair. Consumables including couplant, MT particles, penetrant, developer and PPE have reorder levels and a low-stock flag. Purchase records calibration labs as vendors with accreditation number and expiry, and order lines link to the serial being serviced.

Procedures for mine owner audits and Saskatchewan regulators

Mine owners in Saskatchewan run formal contractor management programs, and pressure equipment at mills, power plants and processing sites falls under the Technical Safety Authority of Saskatchewan (TSASK). Nuclear sites in the north are overseen by the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission, which also licenses industrial radiography. The ERP does not interpret any of these requirements, but it keeps your controlled documents ready for the people who check them.

The Procedures app holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and body text or an uploaded file. Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states. Approved revisions are locked, every revision is snapshotted, and approvers receive notifications and reminders.

An AI-assisted first draft helps a Level III write a site-specific procedure for, say, MFL scanning of a brine tank floor, and falls back to a built-in template; the Level III reviews and approves it. NCR and CAPA workflows are configured during implementation, and company certifications such as ISO 9001 carry alert days.

Fleet, vehicles and winter travel

Saskatoon crews drive long distances on rural highways to mine sites, often in winter. Fleet records each vehicle's purpose, whether it can carry radioactive sources, the transport licence number and expiry, and its assignment to a project and driver with dates and mileage. Mileage by project feeds a clearer picture of what each mine client really costs to serve.

The Maintenance app handles preventive and corrective requests for vehicles and instruments, so winter servicing is scheduled rather than forgotten. Expenses capture fuel, hotel and per diem costs re-billed to jobs.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for shutdowns and call-outs

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Saskatoon handles planned shutdown scopes and urgent call-outs on the same system. Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF, with online acceptance and conversion to a sales order.

Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup time with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag and rate multiplier, and require approval. Standby during a delayed mill lockout and travel days to northern sites are captured rather than lost. Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals and lines showing cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. GST and PST are configured during implementation, and the financial dashboard shows revenue, gross margin, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months.

Inspection management software in Saskatoon: dashboards and integration

Dashboards give the owner the NDT KPIs that matter: calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue, alongside financial figures. Large mine operators run enterprise maintenance and procurement systems, and the Atlantis ERP's open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. CRM tracks leads by service line, industry sector and estimated technicians and days, scores them 0 to 100 and supports drip sequences, and business card scanning turns cards from mining trade events into leads.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Saskatoon: implementation

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Saskatoon is configured around your mine clients, your rotations and your shop work. Atlantis NDT sets up and supports the system; pricing is quote on request.

  1. Discovery. Client sites, shutdown calendars, rotations, methods and report formats.
  2. Data load. Certificates, radiation safety details, vision tests, instruments, calibration history, vehicles and procedures.
  3. Templates. Thickness survey, MFL, weld and invoice templates matching client requirements.
  4. Configuration. Alerts, approvals, rate types, cost centres, taxes and integrations.
  5. Field rollout. Offline app tested in a mill building or other low-signal area.

Founder Anoop Rayavarapu is an ASNT NDT Level III. Book a Saskatoon NDT ERP demo.

Frequently asked questions

Is there NDT software in Saskatoon built for potash mine inspection?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP includes UT thickness, MFL, holiday/coating, MT and weld report types with an offline field app, configured for the reports mine clients expect.

Can scheduling handle northern fly-in rotations?

Yes. Rotation periods can be entered in the availability calendar, and overlapping bookings of technicians or equipment are blocked.

Can the ERP record radiation safety training and badge numbers?

Yes. The employee NDT profile holds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, and other radiation certificates can be stored as certificate records.

Does it integrate with a mine operator's SAP system?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo and other systems accepting API connections, with scope agreed per implementation.

Do you provide ISO 9712 training?

No. Atlantis training is ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based only; ISO 9712 certificates are recorded in the ERP.

What does the Atlantis ERP cost?

Quote on request. It depends on the apps, templates and integrations in scope.
